svg.title: Brightdesk Office Suite app centre concept
svg.desc: Proposed Brightdesk app centre showing ten individual app icons, descriptions, installed and update states, Open, Update and Download buttons, a sidebar and an example three-dot app menu.
svg.text: Everything you need, all in one place.
Keep your Brightdesk apps up to date.
Use the three-dot menu on an app card for more actions, settings and uninstall options.
CONCEPT PREVIEW · Proposed app-centre layout and controls. Actions shown here are design targets, not a claim that every control is already implemented.
